payload.detail: REPORTING HALF SHIPPED 2026-09-18 (PR #2884, merged). A red CI run on a main push now opens or updates a rolling GitHub issue, copying the find-or-create step eval-canary.yml already had rather than inventing one. It is report-only by construction: check-github-action-pins.mjs bans workflow-authored branch mutation, so it cannot commit, push or self-heal. WHAT THIS ROW STILL CARRIES: the reporting is unconfirmed against a real failure — it was verified by the workflow tests (test:ci-workflows), not by watching it fire. Main is currently red for exactly one known reason (#9Z197J, the Firefox/WebKit release-browser-matrix), so the first issue it opens will most likely be that one; treat that as the mechanism working, not a new fault. Close this row once a real red main has produced an issue that reached a person.
